executables.ffmpeg: on PATH; needs libx264 and native aac encoders (verified with 8.1.2)

fonts.note: not bundled (proprietary/OS fonts); looked up by file name in C:/Windows/Fonts/ (common.FONTS)

required.fallback: any Noto Sans JP / Noto Sans CJK JP variable font with a wght axis; edit common.jp()

required.use: Latin product name, numbers, URL, brand
required.fallback: any variable sans with named instances Bold/SemiBold; edit common.lat()

outputs: $RYOSHU_OUT/deliver and $RYOSHU_OUT/build (default: the parent folder of this source folder)
